subject: Graduate Engineer Remedial application, Marc Darenz Masarate

Hi hiring team,

I am applying via SEEK for the Graduate Engineer Remedial role (job 95192751).

I hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering and finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design in February 2026, with road, earthworks, pavement and stormwater design in Civil 3D and AutoCAD plus structural subjects and Revit modelling in study. From April 2019 to February 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as project-in-charge and field engineer, reviewing drawings, inspecting work and keeping site records. I am Melton based, hold a White Card and an Australian driver licence, have full working rights on a Subclass 485 visa until December 2027, and I am open to discussing relocation to Sydney.

The focus on building inspections, defect assessments and remedial documentation is new to me in paid work; my site background is civil delivery rather than façade remediation.

I have attached my resume and cover letter.

Marc Darenz Masarate

macdarenz@gmail.com
